messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Observed runtime OOMs on gpu-pool-3; paging events and elevated 503s for a subset of requests. Impact: ~28% of requests to /v1/generate failing. Paged to oncall.

oncall: I'm on it. grabbing latest dashboards and kube logs. tagging infra.

sara: seeing repeated KV cache growth spikes in the heatmap starting 09:12 UTC. attaching quick trace: https://redwood.internal/trace/4981234567

mike: dump from gpu-exporter: 
```
gpu_id=3 memory_total_mb=49152 memory_used_mb=46720 free_mb=2432 page_faults=4126 local_alloc_frag_pct=18.3
kv_cache_entries=1.9M kv_cache_bytes=3.4GB active_batches=12 avg_batch_size=22
```

ashley: that avg_batch_size=22 is concerning for long-context requests; we've seen fragmentation when batch sizes spike.

devin: hypothesis 1: large concurrent chat sessions caused KV cache to bloat + long KV chains -> increased page faults. hypothesis 2: a new client workload with long seq len (>=4096) hit pool and prevented timely eviction.

oncall: can we reduce max batch size and force earlier eviction as a quick mitigation?

sara: doing a hot rollback of batching policy on gpu-pool-3: setting max_batch_tokens=4096 -> 2048 and max_batch_items=16 -> 8. applying now.

mike: pushed patch to runtime config: 
```
PATCH /configs/runtime/gpu-pool-3
set max_batch_items=8
set kvcache_eviction_threshold=0.65
```
applied 09:21 UTC.

ashley: also triggered manual kvcache-trim for the pool: `./tools/kvtrim --pool gpu-pool-3 --shrink-to 1.2G`

devin: after changes, observing page_faults drop from 4126 -> 520 over 60s, free_mb up from 2.4GB -> 10.8GB. errors to /v1/generate down to ~3% in dashboards.

oncall: customer-impact note: started spike at 09:11 UTC, degraded until mitigation at 09:21 UTC. estimated affected customers: 5 orgs heavy on long-context chat. Notified CS.

sara: saving logs to the incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/4981234567/logs.tar.gz (includes runtime, exporter, kvcache samples).

mike: leaving a snippet of the most relevant stacktrace in case it disappears: 
```
runtime error: allocator OOM: allocate 2048MB failed in chunk_map::reserve at allocator.cc:421
backtrace: kernel_alloc -> memmgr::reserve -> kvcache::persist_chain
```

devin: next action items: 1) run fuller memtrace on a repro node (assigned: devin), 2) evaluate changes to default max_batch_items for the pool family (assigned: sara), 3) add a guard to reject requests above 4096 tokens with informative error before they hit the pool (assigned: mike).

ashley: I'll prep a short customer blurb for the 5 affected orgs and coordinate any followups with CS.

oncall: handing off to @oncall for next shift in 2 hours; please include timeline + artifact links in the postmortem. Good catch on the rapid kvcache growth.

sara: brief timeline (to add to RCA): 09:11 UTC first pagefault surge; 09:12 UTC KV cache heatmap shows growth; 09:14 UTC errors spike to 28%; 09:18 UTC mitigation plan approved; 09:21 UTC batching config rolled + kvtrim; 09:24 UTC error rate receded to baseline.

mike: leaving this thread open for log uploads and the RCA doc link. I'll start the draft and link: https://redwood.internal/rca/4981234567-draft

devin: adding hypotheses to the draft RCA: (A) KV cache chain retention due to long-lived chat sessions, (B) request fanout combined with high avg_batch_size causing allocator fragmentation, (C) potential regression in eviction heuristics rolled last week.

oncall: thanks team. moving to watch mode; if anything re-appears ping @oncall and re-escalate. :thumbsup:
